# PDF Ninja (qpdf-gui)

> Free, open-source Windows desktop application for everyday PDF tasks — decrypt, merge, split, organize, rotate, compress, and watermark — processed locally using the QPDF engine.

## Project Summary
- **Name**: PDF Ninja (qpdf-gui)
- **Primary Function**: Everyday PDF operations (decrypt, merge, split, organize, rotate, compress, watermark) fast and 100% offline.
- **Platform**: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit standalone executable, WPF framework).
- **Engine**: Powered by QPDF (C++ PDF manipulation engine).
- **Privacy Guarantee**: 100% local execution. Files are never uploaded to any remote server or cloud service.
- **Dependencies**: Zero external dependencies (.NET runtime embedded, single-file publish).
- **License**: MIT License (GUI), Apache 2.0 (bundled QPDF binary).

## Core Capabilities & Features
- **Remove Owner Passwords**: Strips restriction flags allowing copying, printing, editing, and annotating locked PDFs even if owner password is unknown.
- **Remove User Passwords**: Decrypts password-protected PDFs when valid password is supplied.
- **Merge / Split / Organize / Rotate / Watermark**: One screen per operation from a sidebar; no command line.
- **Compress**: JPEG quality picker (Best / Balanced / Smallest) plus maximum-resolution picker (Original / 300 / 150 / 100 DPI) that downsamples oversized color/grayscale scans (JPEG and Flate, direct/indexed) while leaving small pictures and masks alone. Optional web linearization.
- **Honest Results**: Reports plainly when a file was already compressed or scans were already at/below the cap; refuses password-protected inputs with a pointer to Decrypt first.
- **Drag & Drop GUI**: Simple drag-and-drop workflow for PDF files.
- **Secure Password Handling**: Passwords sent directly to QPDF executable via stdin (prevents password exposure in process listing or task manager logs).
- **Original File Preservation**: Non-destructive; creates a new output copy, confirms overwrites, supports cancel.

## System Requirements & Build
- OS: Windows 10/11 x64
- Framework: WPF (.NET Desktop Development)
- Build Tools: Visual Studio 2022 or `dotnet` CLI with MSVC/MSYS2 toolchain.
